note: One short line per scene for the Seedance prompt (the format that followed the blockout on 14 Nov 2026). Keyed by scene name.

lines.Eagle takes the fish: a rainbow trout leaps from a fast mountain river; a bald eagle snatches it and flies away down the valley.
lines.Office window: over the ridge into the city of tall towers; past an office window where a man in a red sweater waves.
lines.Skater ollie: low on the avenue, a skateboarder in a teal hoodie ollies over the lens in slow motion.
lines.Woman strides over: a blonde woman in a white summer dress steps over the lens in slow motion; busy street life around her.
lines.Pasta in the alley: into the brick alley; at a trattoria a man twirls spaghetti, a glass of red wine beside him.
lines.Cat leap: a white cat leaps off a dumpster over the lens in slow motion.
lines.Red car off the quay: a police cruiser chases a red 1990s coupe; the officer bites a pink donut; the coupe launches off the quay.
lines.Cop car and the donut: the donut tumbles toward the lens; the camera flies through its hole into the sea.
lines.Shark: underwater, a great white shark chases the trout up to the surface; end on the trout breaking the surface.
